title: Probe the Engram work subcommand at enable time instead of failing every bind on older binaries
outcome: read_engram_work_binding_from_cli (src/engram_host_adapter.rs:1280) propagates every CLI failure as a hard error out of ensure_engram_child_bound_off_lock, so an Engram build that predates the work subcommand or rejects --sections focus fails every bind and drives the session into the transport-failure/circuit-breaker path instead of degrading to no work binding. run_engram_doctor validates only --project-file/--home/doctor and never probes work, so enablement cannot catch it. Either treat subcommand-unsupported distinctly (a named enable-time failure), or add a work capability probe to doctor validation so enablement fails fast with a named reason. Found by the Claude delegated reviewer (Low); also raised in the consultant review.
